title: Session Inspector data ownership and navigation
summary: An experimental sidebar page shows a session's raw log, chat structures and rendered conversation side by side in a virtual table grouped by turn, step and event. It adds no stream or storage and reads data that the session controller and chat already hold in the browser.
firstReason: A debugging view of the session log stays useful. The upstream design navigates object graphs held in the browser, which the Go UI does not have; the host can render the same grouping directly from the log, a page at a time.

title: Import DeepSeek website chat exports
summary: An experimental plugin imports the ZIP produced by the DeepSeek website's "export all chats" action. The host receives the upload, turns the most recent conversations into stored sessions in a chosen workspace one at a time, and streams progress; the user can then continue any of them.
firstReason: The import is host-side work on a documented export format and is in scope under DH-ADR-1. The upload dialog becomes a plain HTML form with a progress stream; the mapping rules from export to session events must be restated for the Go session format by the area that owns it.
